note: New Mexico's 7 no_catalog rows. 1 added, 6 excluded. The one add was a recreation-area row whose campground has its own recreation.gov facility (10086087) with a catalog the triage never saw.

added.name: South Area Campground (Conchas Lake, USACE)
added.caveat: catalog lists RVs and trailers on all 20 sites but no lengths

excluded.name: Black Canyon Campground - Lower (Gila NF)
excluded.why: the district recommends high-clearance 4x4 on FR 150; a steep stream crossing into the lower camp

excluded.name: Johnson Mesa Campground (Santa Fe NF)
excluded.why: dispersed area closed since the 2022 Hermits Peak/Calf Canyon Fire; no source for RV size

excluded.name: Kingston Campground (Gila NF)
excluded.why: two sites; trailers of 16 ft or less

excluded.name: La Sombra Campground (Taos Canyon)
excluded.why: Taos Canyon camps suit tents and very small trailers; trailers not recommended (no turnaround), several sites behind a creek ford

excluded.name: Las Petacas Campground (Taos Canyon)
excluded.why: tent camping or small trailers up to ~12 ft; only one site takes an RV

dropped_by_triage.name: South Area Campground (Conchas Lake)
dropped_by_triage.why: the campground facility for gap row 248170; cited in entry 13289's website
